scripts.build:native: distribution="${DESKTOP_PET_DISTRIBUTION:-neutral}"; case "$distribution" in neutral|legacy-0.3.16) ;; *) echo 'invalid DESKTOP_PET_DISTRIBUTION' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; export DESKTOP_PET_DISTRIBUTION="$distribution"; set --; if [ -n "${DESKTOP_PET_CARGO_TARGET:-}" ]; then set -- --target "$DESKTOP_PET_CARGO_TARGET"; fi; cargo build --release --locked --workspace --target-dir "native/target/$distribution" "$@" --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
